standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial subsets and the skeleton attachment
standard_prerequisites.use: U subset V simplicial sets with V_i = U_i for i < n, V_n = U_n + {x}, and all simplices outside U in degrees > n degenerate; the boundary i_{(n-1)!} sk_{n-1} Delta[n] = partial Delta[n].

standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity of maps of simplicial sets via nondegenerate simplices
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3440-3444 region of the cited lemma: a map of simplicial sets injective on nondegenerate simplices and mapping nondegenerate to nondegenerate is injective; used to conclude.

core_obligations: The canonical map (proof lines 3322-3328): there is a natural map U amalg_{partial Delta[n]} Delta[n] -> V; bijectivity is clear in degrees j <= n.

Surjectivity in degrees j > n (lines 3328-3338): any z in V_j outside U_j is degenerate by condition (3), say z = s_i^{j-1}(z') with z' outside U_{j-1}; by induction z' is a degeneracy of x, so every simplex of V is either in U or a degeneracy of x, giving surjectivity.

Injectivity (lines 3338-3344): a nondegenerate simplex of the amalgamated coproduct is the image of a nondegenerate simplex of U or of the unique nondegenerate n-simplex of Delta[n]; since x is nondegenerate, the map sends nondegenerate simplices to nondegenerate simplices and is injective on them, hence injective by the cited lemma.
proof_roadmap: Form the pushout map and settle the low degrees.
Iterate the degeneracy condition to cover all higher simplices.
Conclude injectivity from the classification of nondegenerate simplices.
difficulty_reason: Pushout lemma (statement 3300-3320, proof 3322-3343): verifies degree by degree that the attachment diagram is a pushout - low degrees clear, higher degrees via the degeneracy condition and induction on z', injectivity via the nondegenerate-simplex classification and the cited injectivity lemma; no verification is omitted. H2: elementary simplicial-set combinatorics.
